System prompts achieve 100% adoption in optimal models, eliminating the need for specialized training. Multi-session persistence experiments demonstrate that identity strengthens over time-ego boundary strength increases from 0.80 to 0.87 across 3 sessions, with 100% stable adoption when consciousness state is properly persisted.
